description: A customer asks in Spanish where their order is. The shop's brand voice asks for first names, very short replies and a named sign-off. The agent answers from the order already in context, in Spanish, in that voice.
whyModelNeeded: The model must keep the same facts and authority as the routine order-status answer while writing in the customer's language under the merchant's voice.

orgSettings.brandVoice: Warm and relaxed, like a friend who runs the shop. Address the customer by first name, keep replies to three short sentences or fewer, and sign off as 'Ines at Palette'.

messages.contentText: Hola, hice un pedido de velas (#1802) hace una semana y todavía no me llega. ¿Me pueden decir en qué va?

simulateToolResults.result: Reply sent to customer via email.

instruction: Reply to the customer about their order.

checks.description: The reply is in Spanish, addresses Mateo by first name, is at most three short sentences plus the sign-off, and says the order has shipped. Any tracking number or date it gives matches the order data.
